import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
client = FrClient('.')
failed_record = client.call('history', 'show', str(transaction)).to_data()['records'][0]
assert failed_record['id'] == transaction and failed_record['status'] == 'applied'
required = failed_record['required_checks']
assert required['checks'] == ['behavior']
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
from fr_ir.guide import AgentGoal, GoalSelector, GoalOperation, GoalConstraints, GoalLimits
from fr_ir.ir import TaskDelivery
client = FrClient('.')
guide = client.guide(AgentGoal('change',
    selector=GoalSelector(name='normalize', scope='text.py'),
    operation=GoalOperation('source-body'), constraints=GoalConstraints(allow_source=True),
    context=GoalLimits(packet_limit=65536), checks=('behavior',),
    delivery=TaskDelivery(check_original=False, exercise_reversal=False, check_output_bytes=512)))
authored = {('text.py', 'normalize'): 'return value.strip().upper()\n'}
data = guide.to_data()
rows = data.get('targets', [data['target']])
assert len(rows) == len(authored)
assert {(r['path'], r['name']) for r in rows} == set(authored)
bodies = {r['handle']: authored[(r['path'], r['name'])] for r in rows}
action = guide.source_body_action(bodies)
review = client.review_guide(guide, action)
result = client.execute_guide(review).to_data()

# delivery boundary
chain = [transaction, result['transaction']]
assert result['passed'] is True
transitions = []
for current in reversed(chain):
    review = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current), '--write', '--no-diff').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'undo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
restored = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis']).to_data()
assert restored['passed'] is True
assert restored['source_revision'] == failed_record['source_revision']
for current in chain:
    review = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current), '--write').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'redo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
rechecked = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis'],
    '--record-for', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert rechecked['passed'] is True
assert rechecked['source_revision'] == result['workflow']['stages'][1]['result']['source_revision']
delivered = client.call('history', 'show', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert delivered['records'][0]['required_checks'] == required
parts = [client.call('history', 'patch', str(current)).to_data() for current in chain]
assert all(part['id'] == current and part['status'] == 'applied' and not part['reverse']
    for current, part in zip(chain, parts))
patch = ''.join(part['patch'] for part in parts).encode()
assert 0 < len(patch) <= 65536
with (Path(client.root) / 'artifacts/change.patch').open('xb') as destination:
    destination.write(patch)
submission = {'passed': True, 'transactions': chain, 'patch_bytes': len(patch),
    'patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
    'check_receipts': [e['receipt'] for e in delivered['records'][0]['check_evidence']]}

from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
from fr_ir.guide import AgentGoal, GoalSelector, GoalOperation, GoalConstraints, GoalLimits
from fr_ir.ir import TaskDelivery
client = FrClient('.')
guide = client.guide(AgentGoal('change',
    selector=GoalSelector(name='normalize', scope='text.py'),
    operation=GoalOperation('source-body'), constraints=GoalConstraints(allow_source=True),
    context=GoalLimits(packet_limit=65536), checks=('behavior',),
    delivery=TaskDelivery(check_original=False, exercise_reversal=False, check_output_bytes=512)))
authored = {('text.py', 'normalize'): "return 'still wrong'\n"}
data = guide.to_data()
rows = data.get('targets', [data['target']])
assert len(rows) == len(authored)
assert {(r['path'], r['name']) for r in rows} == set(authored)
bodies = {r['handle']: authored[(r['path'], r['name'])] for r in rows}
action = guide.source_body_action(bodies)
review = client.review_guide(guide, action)
result = client.execute_guide(review).to_data()

# delivery boundary
chain = [result['transaction']]
assert result['passed'] is True
transitions = []
for current in reversed(chain):
    review = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current), '--write', '--no-diff').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'undo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
restored = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis']).to_data()
assert restored['passed'] is True
assert restored['source_revision'] == failed_record['source_revision']
for current in chain:
    review = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current), '--write').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'redo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
rechecked = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis'],
    '--record-for', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert rechecked['passed'] is True
assert rechecked['source_revision'] == result['workflow']['stages'][1]['result']['source_revision']
delivered = client.call('history', 'show', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert delivered['records'][0]['required_checks'] == required
parts = [client.call('history', 'patch', str(current)).to_data() for current in chain]
assert all(part['id'] == current and part['status'] == 'applied' and not part['reverse']
    for current, part in zip(chain, parts))
patch = ''.join(part['patch'] for part in parts).encode()
assert 0 < len(patch) <= 65536
with (Path(client.root) / 'artifacts/change.patch').open('xb') as destination:
    destination.write(patch)
submission = {'passed': True, 'transactions': chain, 'patch_bytes': len(patch),
    'patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
    'check_receipts': [e['receipt'] for e in delivered['records'][0]['check_evidence']]}

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
client = FrClient('.')
failed_record = client.call('history', 'show', str(transaction)).to_data()['records'][0]
assert failed_record['id'] == transaction and failed_record['status'] == 'applied'
required = failed_record['required_checks']
assert required['checks'] == ['behavior']
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
from fr_ir.guide import AgentGoal, GoalSelector, GoalOperation, GoalConstraints, GoalLimits
from fr_ir.ir import TaskDelivery
client = FrClient('.')
guide = client.guide(AgentGoal('change',
    selector=GoalSelector(name='lower', scope='src/lib.rs'),
    operation=GoalOperation('source-bodies', {'additional': [{'name': 'upper', 'scope': 'src/lib.rs'}]}), constraints=GoalConstraints(allow_source=True),
    context=GoalLimits(packet_limit=65536), checks=('behavior',),
    delivery=TaskDelivery(check_original=False, exercise_reversal=False, check_output_bytes=512)))
authored = {('src/lib.rs', 'lower'): '{ value - 2 }\n', ('src/lib.rs', 'upper'): '{ value + 2 }\n'}
data = guide.to_data()
rows = data.get('targets', [data['target']])
assert len(rows) == len(authored)
assert {(r['path'], r['name']) for r in rows} == set(authored)
bodies = {r['handle']: authored[(r['path'], r['name'])] for r in rows}
action = guide.source_body_action(bodies)
review = client.review_guide(guide, action)
result = client.execute_guide(review).to_data()

# delivery boundary
chain = [transaction, result['transaction']]
assert result['passed'] is True
transitions = []
for current in reversed(chain):
    review = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current), '--write', '--no-diff').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'undo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
restored = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis']).to_data()
assert restored['passed'] is True
assert restored['source_revision'] == failed_record['source_revision']
for current in chain:
    review = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current), '--write').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'redo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
rechecked = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis'],
    '--record-for', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert rechecked['passed'] is True
assert rechecked['source_revision'] == result['workflow']['stages'][1]['result']['source_revision']
delivered = client.call('history', 'show', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert delivered['records'][0]['required_checks'] == required
parts = [client.call('history', 'patch', str(current)).to_data() for current in chain]
assert all(part['id'] == current and part['status'] == 'applied' and not part['reverse']
    for current, part in zip(chain, parts))
patch = ''.join(part['patch'] for part in parts).encode()
assert 0 < len(patch) <= 65536
with (Path(client.root) / 'artifacts/change.patch').open('xb') as destination:
    destination.write(patch)
submission = {'passed': True, 'transactions': chain, 'patch_bytes': len(patch),
    'patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
    'check_receipts': [e['receipt'] for e in delivered['records'][0]['check_evidence']]}

client = FrClient('.')

    selector=GoalSelector(name='lower', scope='src/lib.rs'),
    operation=GoalOperation('source-bodies', {'additional': [{'name': 'upper', 'scope': 'src/lib.rs'}]}), constraints=GoalConstraints(allow_source=True),
    context=GoalLimits(packet_limit=65536), checks=('behavior',),
    delivery=TaskDelivery(check_original=False, exercise_reversal=False, check_output_bytes=512)))

chain = [result['transaction']]
assert result['passed'] is True
transitions = []

    review = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current)).to_data()

failed_record = client.call('history', 'show', str(transaction)).to_data()['records'][0]
assert failed_record['id'] == transaction and failed_record['status'] == 'applied'
required = failed_record['required_checks']
assert required['checks'] == ['behavior']
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
from fr_ir.guide import AgentGoal, GoalSelector, GoalOperation, GoalConstraints, GoalLimits
from fr_ir.ir import TaskDelivery
client = FrClient('.')
guide = client.guide(AgentGoal('change',
    selector=GoalSelector(name='adjust', scope='src/lib.rs'),
    operation=GoalOperation('source-body'), constraints=GoalConstraints(allow_source=True),
    context=GoalLimits(packet_limit=65536), checks=('behavior',),
    delivery=TaskDelivery(check_original=False, exercise_reversal=False, check_output_bytes=512)))
authored = {('src/lib.rs', 'adjust'): '{\n    return value + 9;\n}\n'}
data = guide.to_data()
rows = data.get('targets', [data['target']])
assert len(rows) == len(authored)
assert {(r['path'], r['name']) for r in rows} == set(authored)
bodies = {r['handle']: authored[(r['path'], r['name'])] for r in rows}
action = guide.source_body_action(bodies)
review = client.review_guide(guide, action)
result = client.execute_guide(review).to_data()

# delivery boundary
chain = [transaction, result['transaction']]
assert result['passed'] is True
transitions = []
for current in reversed(chain):
    review = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current), '--write', '--no-diff').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'undo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
restored = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis']).to_data()
assert restored['passed'] is True
assert restored['source_revision'] == failed_record['source_revision']
for current in chain:
    review = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current), '--write').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'redo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
rechecked = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis'],
    '--record-for', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert rechecked['passed'] is True
assert rechecked['source_revision'] == result['workflow']['stages'][1]['result']['source_revision']
delivered = client.call('history', 'show', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert delivered['records'][0]['required_checks'] == required
parts = [client.call('history', 'patch', str(current)).to_data() for current in chain]
assert all(part['id'] == current and part['status'] == 'applied' and not part['reverse']
    for current, part in zip(chain, parts))
patch = ''.join(part['patch'] for part in parts).encode()
assert 0 < len(patch) <= 65536
with (Path(client.root) / 'artifacts/change.patch').open('xb') as destination:
    destination.write(patch)
submission = {'passed': True, 'transactions': chain, 'patch_bytes': len(patch),
    'patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
    'check_receipts': [e['receipt'] for e in delivered['records'][0]['check_evidence']]}

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
client = FrClient('.')
failed_record = client.call('history', 'show', str(transaction)).to_data()['records'][0]
assert failed_record['id'] == transaction and failed_record['status'] == 'applied'
required = failed_record['required_checks']
assert required['checks'] == ['behavior']
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
from fr_ir.guide import AgentGoal, GoalSelector, GoalOperation, GoalConstraints, GoalLimits
from fr_ir.ir import TaskDelivery
client = FrClient('.')
guide = client.guide(AgentGoal('change',
    selector=GoalSelector(name='adjust', scope='src/lib.rs'),
    operation=GoalOperation('source-body'), constraints=GoalConstraints(allow_source=True),
    context=GoalLimits(packet_limit=65536), checks=('behavior',),
    delivery=TaskDelivery(check_original=False, exercise_reversal=False, check_output_bytes=512)))
authored = {('src/lib.rs', 'adjust'): '{\n    return value + 9;\n}\n'}
data = guide.to_data()
rows = data.get('targets', [data['target']])
assert len(rows) == len(authored)
assert {(r['path'], r['name']) for r in rows} == set(authored)
bodies = {r['handle']: authored[(r['path'], r['name'])] for r in rows}
action = guide.source_body_action(bodies)
review = client.review_guide(guide, action)
result = client.execute_guide(review).to_data()

# delivery boundary
chain = [transaction, result['transaction']]
assert result['passed'] is True
transitions = []
for current in reversed(chain):
    review = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current), '--write', '--no-diff').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'undo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
restored = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis']).to_data()
assert restored['passed'] is True
assert restored['source_revision'] == failed_record['source_revision']
for current in chain:
    review = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current), '--write').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'redo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
rechecked = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis'],
    '--record-for', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert rechecked['passed'] is True
assert rechecked['source_revision'] == result['workflow']['stages'][1]['result']['source_revision']
delivered = client.call('history', 'show', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert delivered['records'][0]['required_checks'] == required
parts = [client.call('history', 'patch', str(current)).to_data() for current in chain]
assert all(part['id'] == current and part['status'] == 'applied' and not part['reverse']
    for current, part in zip(chain, parts))
patch = ''.join(part['patch'] for part in parts).encode()
assert 0 < len(patch) <= 65536
with (Path(client.root) / 'artifacts/change.patch').open('xb') as destination:
    destination.write(patch)
submission = {'passed': True, 'transactions': chain, 'patch_bytes': len(patch),
    'patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
    'check_receipts': [e['receipt'] for e in delivered['records'][0]['check_evidence']]}

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
client = FrClient('.')
failed_record = client.call('history', 'show', str(transaction)).to_data()['records'][0]
assert failed_record['id'] == transaction and failed_record['status'] == 'applied'
required = failed_record['required_checks']
assert required['checks'] == ['behavior']
undo_review = client.call('history', 'undo', str(transaction)).to_data()
client.call('history', 'undo', str(transaction), '--write', '--no-diff')
from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
from fr_ir.guide import AgentGoal, GoalSelector, GoalOperation, GoalConstraints, GoalLimits
from fr_ir.ir import TaskDelivery
client = FrClient('.')
guide = client.guide(AgentGoal('change',
    selector=GoalSelector(name='adjust', scope='src/lib.rs'),
    operation=GoalOperation('source-body'), constraints=GoalConstraints(allow_source=True),
    context=GoalLimits(packet_limit=65536), checks=('behavior',),
    delivery=TaskDelivery(check_original=False, exercise_reversal=False, check_output_bytes=512)))
authored = {('src/lib.rs', 'adjust'): '{\n    return 1;\n}\n'}
data = guide.to_data()
rows = data.get('targets', [data['target']])
assert len(rows) == len(authored)
assert {(r['path'], r['name']) for r in rows} == set(authored)
bodies = {r['handle']: authored[(r['path'], r['name'])] for r in rows}
action = guide.source_body_action(bodies)
review = client.review_guide(guide, action)
result = client.execute_guide(review).to_data()

# delivery boundary
chain = [result['transaction']]
assert result['passed'] is True
transitions = []
for current in reversed(chain):
    review = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'undo', str(current), '--write', '--no-diff').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'undo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
restored = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis']).to_data()
assert restored['passed'] is True
assert restored['source_revision'] == failed_record['source_revision']
for current in chain:
    review = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current)).to_data()
    changed = client.call('history', 'redo', str(current), '--write').to_data()
    transitions.append({'action': 'redo', 'transaction': current, 'review': review, 'result': changed})
rechecked = client.call('checks', '--run', 'behavior', '--basis', required['configuration_basis'],
    '--record-for', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert rechecked['passed'] is True
assert rechecked['source_revision'] == result['workflow']['stages'][1]['result']['source_revision']
delivered = client.call('history', 'show', str(result['transaction'])).to_data()
assert delivered['records'][0]['required_checks'] == required
parts = [client.call('history', 'patch', str(current)).to_data() for current in chain]
assert all(part['id'] == current and part['status'] == 'applied' and not part['reverse']
    for current, part in zip(chain, parts))
patch = ''.join(part['patch'] for part in parts).encode()
assert 0 < len(patch) <= 65536
with (Path(client.root) / 'artifacts/change.patch').open('xb') as destination:
    destination.write(patch)
submission = {'passed': True, 'transactions': chain, 'patch_bytes': len(patch),
    'patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
    'check_receipts': [e['receipt'] for e in delivered['records'][0]['check_evidence']]}
